[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Elizabeth was born in 1762. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-2868|James Glasgow]] and [[Hartshorne-320|Ann Hartshorne]]. She passed away in 1857.


== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2868]] is assessed at 95% (proved). Elizabeth Mary’s distinctive combined name and Cecil setting match the Maryland State Archives summary of James Sr./Ann’s children. Later-life dates remain derivative and the father’s Scottish childhood is not proved.

Named child to the specific adult family role represented by the selected father; independent earlier ancestry is outside this assessment.
